verses.text: Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

segments.text: Sing aloud unto God our strength:
Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

verses.text: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.

segments.text: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel,
The pleasant harp with the psaltery.

verses.text: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.

segments.text: Blow the trumpet at the new moon,
At the full moon, on our feast-day.

verses.text: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

segments.text: For it is a statute for Israel,
An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

verses.text: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, Where I heard a language that I knew not.

segments.text: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony,
When he went out over the land of Egypt,
Where
I heard a language that I knew not.

verses.text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.

segments.text: I removed his shoulder from the burden:
His hands were freed from the basket.

verses.text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. [Selah

segments.text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee;
I answered thee in the secret place of thunder;
I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. [Selah

verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

segments.text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee:
O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!

verses.text: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

segments.text: There shall no strange god be in thee;
Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.

verses.text: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

segments.text: I am Jehovah thy God,
Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt:
Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.text: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.

segments.text: But my people hearkened not to my voice;
And Israel would none of me.

verses.text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

segments.text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart,
That they might walk in their own counsels.

verses.text: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!

segments.text: Oh that my people would hearken unto me,
That Israel would walk in my ways!

verses.text: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.

segments.text: I would soon subdue their enemies,
And turn my hand against their adversaries.

verses.text: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.

segments.text: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him:
But their time should endure for ever.

verses.text: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.

segments.text: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat;

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of Asaph.
